name: Competing local publications
oracle: At most one distinct operation successfully publishes from a given expected local generation; success advances it. Every other operation using the old expectation conflicts; identical retries return the existing receipt.

name: Crash matrix
oracle: Before durable acknowledgement, crash recovery exposes old or new complete revision. After LOCAL_COMMITTED acknowledgement, the revision remains recoverable and the durable head is that commit or a later valid transition; no acknowledged commit disappears. Every unfinished receipt is resumable or terminal.

name: Canonical identity vectors
oracle: Independent C/Rust/Swift/JS readers accept the published golden vectors, reject wrong versions/lengths and never exchange path/pose hashes for ObjectId.

name: Fail-closed mediation
oracle: Unknown judge, saturated callback registry, direct emitter and forged/stale/replayed grant produce no unauthorized effect; unknown verdict alone is non-authorizing.

name: Transport/application mismatch
oracle: HTTP200 with typed application error, disconnect after accept and duplicate reply cannot update the view to successful dehydration.

name: Resolved-path confinement
oracle: Link replacement, sibling prefixes, substituted targets and metacharacter names cannot escape the scoped adapter or become shell syntax.

name: Offline/replica causality
oracle: Offline divergent edits retain both causal versions; reconnect creates explicit merge/conflict and never infers correctness from model agreement.

name: Eviction/restore
oracle: No eviction before verified recoverability and retention allowance; missing/corrupt provider objects preserve local bytes and fail eligibility.

name: Honest view values
oracle: Zero remains zero; unknown stays unknown; stale/empty/unavailable remain distinguishable; simulated metrics cannot masquerade as measured.

name: Native contract/build gates
oracle: Selected macOS and Windows host builds run the same contract fixtures; iOS path/packaging gates are separate; local endpoint configuration persists.

name: Independent governance evidence
oracle: Empty signatures fail schema; unavailable crypto tools are SKIP/FAIL; no fixed-true clause output can satisfy independent per-clause predicates.

name: Research integration promotion
oracle: Native format/link/runtime/hardware receipts bind toolchain, source, model and device identities; pointer-bearing ABI structs are not used as portable payloads.
